The cleanest underfollowed direct candidate is Preformed Line Products, because external search context identifies it as a public supplier of hardware installed on transmission towers and conductor spans, with MacLean Power Systems private and Hubbell more diversified. Hubbell and Quanta are included as reference/context names, while MYR Group is included as a smaller second-order installer/EPC exposure tied to the same hardware procurement and lineworker labor constraint. This is not a recommendation; candidates are research leads requiring product-level revenue, backlog, utility approval, and customer concentration verification.
